verdict.rationale: SumUp publishes /llms.txt, which a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200, plus /llms-full.txt for bulk ingestion and llms-small.txt. It also documents that any docs page is available as plain Markdown by appending index.md, and that coding assistants can get current SumUp documentation. First-party docs are corroborated by the hands-on probe, so every part of the story is covered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: You can access all of our documentation as plain text Markdown files by adding index.md to the end of any URL.
Give coding assistants current SumUp documentation and tools.
